prompt: An arrow runs from 3-SAT to Independent Set in a polynomial-time reduction map. What would a polynomial-time Independent Set decision algorithm provide?

options.text: A polynomial-time algorithm for 3-SAT by translating first
options.explanation: Correct. Translate the formula, then run the target solver; answer preservation gives a solver for the source.

options.text: Only a way to solve Independent Set on satisfiable formulas
options.explanation: The reduction works for both yes- and no-instances, without knowing satisfiability beforehand.

options.text: A proof that 3-SAT is not in NP
options.explanation: 3-SAT has polynomially checkable assignments, so it is in NP.

options.text: A proof that no algorithm for 3-SAT can exist
options.explanation: The reduction transfers algorithms; it does not establish an unconditional lower bound.

workedExample:
